pokemon.name: Wolvyn
pokemon.appearance: Shaggy brown fur, cream facial and chest markings, dark oversized paws, fluffy cream-tipped tail, mischievous expression.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvyn is small, but it never backs down from a challenge. It fearlessly takes on Pokémon much larger than itself, using its sharp instincts and quick movements to get the upper hand. Its playful and mischievous nature often gets it into trouble, but its determination always helps it push through.
pokemon.notes: Species design, typing, abilities, base stats, and mandatory evolution at level 17 approved. Wolvyn learns moves only before evolving; later moves belong to evolved species.

pokemon.name: Wolvigor
pokemon.notes: Approved Wolvigor profile. Normal artwork linked as 002-Wolvigor.png; corrected shiny artwork awaiting upload under confirmed filename. Level 35 and later family moves belong to Wolvage.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvigor fiercely defends its territory against intruders, regardless of their size. Its powerful claws and relentless determination make it a formidable opponent, and it rarely retreats once a battle begins.
pokemon.appearance: Brown fur with cream markings and dark brown fur and paws.

pokemon.name: Wolvage
pokemon.notes: Final stage, evolves from Wolvigor at level 35. No hidden abilities. No gender-based appearance differences.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Wolvage is a relentless fighter that refuses to surrender, even against overwhelming odds. Its massive claws can tear through solid rock, and its powerful muscles allow it to overpower opponents much larger than itself. Once it sets its sights on a challenge, nothing can convince it to back down.

pokemon.name: Solcub

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: Grants immunity to damaging Fire-type moves and boosts the power of the user's Fire-type attacks by 50% after activation.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.description: In harsh sunlight, increases Special Attack by 50%, but removes ⅛ of maximum HP at the end of each turn.

pokemon.notes: Approved #004 Solcub profile. Preserve exact Pokédex entry and existing normal artwork. Level-up moves on this profile stop before its automatic evolution at Level 18. Evolution EXP is retained.
pokemon.appearance: Small charcoal-black sun bear cub with orange-red fiery highlights, flames around rounded ears, bright yellow crescent chest marking, ember-like claws and paw pads, and amber eyes.
pokemon.personality: Playful, energetic, curious, mischievous and slightly hotheaded; affectionate toward trusted trainers.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solcub is an energetic and curious Pokémon that constantly investigates its surroundings. Its playful nature often leads it into trouble, causing the flames on its ears to flare with excitement. The golden crescent marking on its chest absorbs and stores energy from sunlight, serving as the source of its fiery power. When fully charged, the marking glows brightly, strengthening its flames and allowing Solcub to maintain its body heat even during the coldest nights. Despite its mischievous behavior, Solcub forms strong bonds with those it trusts.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

abilities.description: Grants immunity to damaging Fire-type moves and boosts the power of the user's Fire-type attacks by 50% after activation.

pokemon.notes: Approved #005 Solbruin profile. Existing Pokédex entry and approved normal artwork preserved. Learns only Level 19–35 moves in this stage; no move at evolution Level 18. Retains previously learned Solcub moves (including Ember Claw). Automatically evolves at Level 36 with cumulative EXP retained.
pokemon.appearance: Adolescent quadrupedal sun bear with charcoal-black fur, a fiery orange-red ridge along its spine, pronounced flaming ears and shoulders, strong forelegs, broad shoulders, glowing crescent chest marking and long ember-lit claws.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solbruin is an intelligent and resourceful Pokémon that uses its powerful claws to break apart fallen logs and uncover hidden food. The golden crescent on its chest has grown larger, allowing it to absorb and store far more sunlight than Solcub. This energy fuels the intense flames along its back and shoulders, which burn brighter as its reserves increase. Despite its imposing appearance, Solbruin prefers investigating unfamiliar things over confronting them.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

pokemon.name: Solursus

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: Grants immunity to damaging Fire-type moves and boosts the power of the user's Fire-type moves by 50% after activation.

abilities.name: Solar Power

pokemon.notes: Approved #006 Solursus profile. Existing Pokédex entry and original solo artwork preserved. As the final stage, learns new moves only at Levels 39, 44, 49 and 55. No new evolution move at Level 36. Retains moves previously learned as Solcub or Solbruin (including Ember Claw). Cumulative Medium Slow EXP persists after evolution.
pokemon.personality: Calm, patient, disciplined, and formidable when threatened
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Solursus possesses an enormous reserve of solar energy within the golden crescent on its chest. When fully charged, the marking radiates intense heat, fueling the roaring flames that surround its massive body. Despite its fearsome appearance, Solursus is remarkably patient and rarely wastes energy on unnecessary confrontations. When threatened, however, it releases its stored power in devastating bursts of fire capable of scorching the ground beneath its paws.

custom_moves.name: Ember Claw
custom_moves.description: The user slashes the target with a claw engulfed in flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

pokemon.name: Ripplet
pokemon.appearance: Small, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with smooth deep-teal skin, a lighter cream-blue underside, expressive golden eyes, short sturdy legs and a broad paddle-shaped tail with translucent blue fin edges.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Ripplet spends much of its time hiding beneath smooth stones in shallow streams. Its broad, paddle-shaped tail allows it to glide quietly through the water, creating gentle ripples along the surface. Although usually cautious, Ripplet becomes surprisingly energetic when hunting small aquatic creatures. When startled, it darts toward shelter with a sudden burst of speed.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases the power of Water-type moves by 50% when the Pokémon has one-third or less of its maximum HP remaining.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when successfully affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: Ability A (Torrent) or Ability B (Water Absorb), each with 50% probability. The assigned ability is retained through evolution. No hidden ability.
pokemon.notes: Approved #007 Ripplet profile. Preserve exact Pokédex entry and approved normal artwork. Special-attacking 325 BST. Seven level-up moves through Level 16; Level 20 Mud Shot belongs to Ripplash. Automatic evolution at Level 20 retains accumulated EXP and learned moves. Shiny color palette: deep purple body, pale underside, turquoise fins and golden eyes; no gender-based appearance differences.

pokemon.name: Ripplash
pokemon.appearance: Adolescent, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with a broader head, thicker body, stronger legs and shoulders, deep-teal skin, a lighter underside, golden eyes and a larger muscular paddle-shaped tail with translucent fin edges.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Ripplash has grown increasingly confident as its body and tail become stronger. It patrols the deeper sections of rivers, using its broad tail to stir up sediment and flush hidden prey from the riverbed. Despite its powerful swimming bursts, Ripplash prefers waiting patiently beneath submerged rocks before ambushing its prey. When defending its territory, it slams its tail against the water, producing a thunderous splash that warns intruders to stay away.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases the power of Water-type moves by 50% when the Pokémon has one-third or less of its maximum HP remaining.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One regular ability (Torrent or Water Absorb) is assigned with equal 50% probability and retained from Ripplet through Ripplash and Riptorrent. No hidden ability.
pokemon.notes: Approved #008 Ripplash. Original normal artwork and exact Pokédex entry preserved. Retains 435 BST (higher than Normal/Fire middle evolutions). Learns five new moves at Levels 20,24,28,32,36; Torrent Break at Level 40 belongs to Riptorrent. Inherits previously learned Ripplet moves. Evolves automatically at Level 40 with retained cumulative EXP. Both genders use the same normal and shiny artwork. Approved shiny palette: deep purple body, pale silver underside, bright turquoise tail fins, original golden eyes.

pokemon.name: Riptorrent
pokemon.appearance: Massive, primarily quadrupedal giant-salamander Pokémon with a broad powerful head, heavily muscled body and limbs, deep-teal skin, a lighter underside, golden eyes and an enormous fan-shaped paddle tail with flowing translucent fins.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Riptorrent rules the deepest stretches of rivers, where its enormous body remains nearly motionless beneath the current. Its powerful tail can generate torrents strong enough to sweep away large obstacles and reshape sections of the riverbed. Despite its tremendous strength, Riptorrent is a patient ambush predator that rarely pursues prey over long distances. When its territory is threatened, it unleashes a violent surge of water before disappearing into the depths.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Increases Water-type move power by 50% while HP is at one-third of maximum or lower.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Water-type moves and restores 25% of maximum HP when successfully affected by one.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One of two mutually exclusive regular abilities, each with equal (50%) assignment probability; the ability assigned to Ripplet is retained through Ripplash and Riptorrent. No hidden abilities.
pokemon.notes: Approved #009 Riptorrent. Preserve exact Pokédex description and existing normal artwork. Final-stage moves are Torrent Break at Level 40, Dive Level 44, Whirlpool Level 49, and Hydro Cannon Level 55. Torrent Break is Riptorrent's exclusive approved Everwild signature move. Prior stage moves and cumulative EXP are retained when evolving at Level 40. Approved 550 BST intentionally exceeds the Normal/Fire final stages.

custom_moves.name: Torrent Break
custom_moves.effect: 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.
custom_moves.description: A powerful torrent strikes the target and may lower its Speed.

pokemon.name: Foliko
pokemon.appearance: Small cute leaf-tailed gecko with golden eyes, cream underside, green-and-brown leaf camouflage, leafy head frills, wide gripping toes and broad leaf-shaped tail.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: Boosts the power of Grass-type moves by 50% when HP is at one-third of maximum or less.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: Allows the user's moves to bypass Substitute and applicable protective barriers such as Reflect and Light Screen.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Foliko spends most of its day hiding among fallen leaves and low branches. Its leaf-shaped tail and mottled skin make it nearly impossible to distinguish from surrounding foliage. When startled, it freezes completely, relying on its camouflage to escape detection. Curious by nature, it often follows unfamiliar sounds before quickly retreating into hiding.
pokemon.notes: Approved #010 Foliko. Exact existing Pokédex entry and normal artwork preserved; existing approved autumn shiny linked. Pure Grass, fast special attacker, 310 BST. Six stage moves at Levels 1–13; Leech Seed at Level 16 belongs to Folisk. Evolves at Level 16 into Folisk and at Level 32 into Foliraptor, retaining cumulative Medium Slow EXP and previously learned moves. No gender appearance differences; shiny uses burnt orange/copper body, golden-amber tail, pale cream markings, original golden eyes.
pokemon.ability_assignment: One of the two regular abilities is assigned with equal (50%) probability and is retained through Folisk and Foliraptor. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Folisk
pokemon.appearance: Agile adolescent leaf-tailed gecko with longer limbs, more angular leafy crest, green-brown camouflage and a larger raised leaf-shaped tail.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: Increases the power of Grass-type moves by 50% when HP falls to one-third of maximum or lower.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: Allows the user's moves to bypass Substitute and applicable protective barriers such as Reflect and Light Screen.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Folisk is an agile climber that spends much of its life high in the forest canopy. Its enlarged toe pads allow it to cling securely to branches, even while hanging upside down. It patiently waits among the leaves for unsuspecting prey, striking with remarkable speed before disappearing back into the foliage.
pokemon.notes: Approved #011 Folisk. Preserve existing Pokédex entry and normal solo artwork exactly. Use actual uploaded shiny filename #011 Folisk (Shiny).png (the spec's 011_Folisk_Shiny.png does not match repository). Six middle-stage moves at Levels 16–31; Leech Seed at Level 16 is the regular stage-specific move, not an extra evolution-exclusive move. Leaf Storm at Level 32 belongs to Foliraptor. EXP and previous moves are retained across evolutions. No gender visual differences; shiny palette burnt orange/copper, golden amber leaf tail, pale cream markings, unchanged golden eyes.
pokemon.ability_assignment: Each Pokémon has either Overgrow or Infiltrator with equal 50% probability. The ability assigned to Foliko is retained through Folisk and Foliraptor. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Foliraptor
pokemon.appearance: Athletic mature canopy gecko with elaborate layered leafy frills, elongated limbs, golden eyes and a large camouflage leaf-shaped tail.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: Increases Grass-type move power by 50% when HP is at one-third of maximum or lower.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: Allows the user's moves to bypass Substitute and applicable protective barriers, including Reflect and Light Screen.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Foliraptor is a master of camouflage, capable of remaining completely undetected among dense forest vegetation. Its elaborate leaf-like scales blend seamlessly into the canopy, allowing it to ambush prey without warning. Despite its intimidating appearance, Foliraptor rarely confronts larger Pokémon, preferring to use its exceptional agility to escape danger.
pokemon.notes: Approved #012 Foliraptor. Preserve exact existing Pokédex entry and normal solo artwork. Link existing shiny art under its actual repository filename '#012 Foliraptor (Shiny).png' (not the proposed filename 012_Foliraptor_Shiny.png). Seven stage-only moves Levels 32,35,39,43,47,51,55; Leaf Storm at Level 32 is its regular level-up move, with no additional evolution-exclusive move. Inherits Foliko and Folisk moves and cumulative EXP, reaches Level 100 at 1,059,860 EXP. Autumn shiny palette: copper/orange body and foliage, golden/amber leaf tail, pale cream markings, original golden eyes. No visual gender differences.
pokemon.ability_assignment: One of two mutually exclusive regular abilities with equal 50% assignment probability when Foliko is generated; the same ability is retained through Folisk and Foliraptor. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Kivolt
pokemon.appearance: Playful golden cheetah cub with black spots, rounded ears, cream chest and paws, dark tear markings, banded lightning-tipped tail, and small static discharges.
pokemon.notes: Approved #013 Kivolt. Preserve exact existing Pokédex entry and normal solo artwork. Existing original silver-white and electric-blue shiny file #013 Kivolt (Shiny).png linked without altering artwork. Kivolt learns seven stage-only moves Levels 1–16; Bite at Level 19 belongs to Kivarra. Automatically evolves into Kivarra at Level 18, then Kivarion at Level 36; accumulated Medium Slow EXP, previously learned moves, and assigned ability carry over. No additional evolution-exclusive move at Level 18. Keep Kivarra/Kivarion intentional artwork swap unchanged.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Kivolt is a playful Pokémon that generates static electricity as it runs through tall grass. Its spotted fur releases tiny sparks whenever it becomes excited. Young Kivolt frequently chase one another, unknowingly developing the extraordinary speed they will possess as adults.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze an opponent when that opponent makes contact.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Electric-type moves and raises Speed by one stage when activated.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One of Static or Motor Drive is assigned with equal (50%) probability when Kivolt is generated, and retained through Kivarra and Kivarion. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Kivarra
pokemon.appearance: Lean adolescent electric cheetah with longer sprinting limbs, angular black markings, spiky fur tufts, banded lightning-tipped tail and bright electrical arcs.
pokemon.notes: Approved #014 Kivarra. Exact existing Pokédex entry and intentional NORMAL artwork assignment #015 Kivarion.png preserved (Kivarion normal uses #014 Kivarra.png). Link Kivarra shiny using actual uploaded file #014 Kivarra (Shiny).png. Six new moves at Levels 19, 22, 25, 28, 31 and 34; Level 36 Extreme Speed belongs to Kivarion. Evolves automatically at Level 36 with accumulated EXP, previously learned moves and assigned ability retained. No extra evolution-exclusive move at Level 18. Identical normal and shiny art for both genders.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Kivarra spends much of its day racing across open grasslands, strengthening its legs and refining its hunting instincts. Specialized pads on its paws absorb the impact of high-speed movement while its fur stores electrical energy. When approaching its maximum speed, bright sparks race along its body.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze an opponent when that opponent makes contact.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Electric-type moves and raises Speed by one stage when activated.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One of two regular abilities, Static (Ability A) or Motor Drive (Ability B), assigned with equal 50% probability when Kivolt is generated. The assigned ability carries through Kivarra and Kivarion. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Kivarion
pokemon.appearance: Athletic adult electric cheetah with a cream chest ruff, swept-back lightning-shaped fur, bold black markings, powerful running limbs, banded tail and vivid electrical arcs.
pokemon.notes: Approved #015 Kivarion. Preserve exact website Pokédex entry, 530 BST, 140 Speed and 120 Attack. Preserve intentionally mapped normal artwork #014 Kivarra.png for Kivarion (#014 Kivarra uses #015 Kivarion.png). The uploaded Kivarion shiny uses its actual filename #015 Kivarion (Shiny).png. Final-stage moves at Levels 36,39,43,47,51,55 only; Extreme Speed is learned at evolution level 36, with no additional evolution-exclusive move. Retain previously learned moves, assigned ability, and cumulative Medium Slow EXP. No gender differences.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Kivarion is an exceptionally fast predator capable of crossing vast grasslands in seconds. Its powerful legs generate tremendous electrical energy with every stride, causing its markings to glow brilliantly. When pursuing prey, Kivarion can release a concentrated burst of electricity to accelerate beyond its normal limits.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: Grants immunity to applicable Electric-type moves and raises Speed by one stage when activated.

pokemon.ability_assignment: One of two mutually exclusive regular abilities, each with 50% assignment probability when Kivolt is generated; the assigned ability persists through Kivarra and Kivarion. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Arctix
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Arctix is a curious and playful Pokémon that spends its days bounding through deep snow. Its thick fur protects it from freezing temperatures, while its sensitive ears can detect movement beneath the ice. When excited, tiny snowflakes form around its paws, often leaving a sparkling trail wherever it runs.
pokemon.appearance: Small white arctic fox kit with oversized blue-lined ears, bright blue eyes, fluffy neck ruff, blue-tipped paws and large bushy tail with pale blue markings.
pokemon.notes: Approved #016 Arctix. Replace previous website entry with exact new approval and rename classification to Frost Kit Pokémon. Preserve solo and artwork #016 Arctix.png and concept assignment 016-arctix.png. Approved existing shiny is #016 Arctix (Shiny).png. Move list covers seven first-stage moves through Level 15; Level 16 evolves automatically into Arctivar, then Level 32 into Arctivale. Maintain cumulative Medium Slow EXP, previously learned moves and original assigned ability; no hidden ability. No visual gender differences.

abilities.description: Raises evasion in snow, effectively reducing the accuracy of applicable incoming moves by 20% while snow is active.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: Restores 1/16 of maximum HP at the end of each turn while snow is active, using standard HP rounding rules.

pokemon.ability_assignment: Each Pokémon has either Snow Cloak or Ice Body with equal (50%) assignment probability. The assigned ability is retained through Arctivar and Arctivale; no hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Arctivar
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Arctivar races effortlessly across frozen landscapes, using its powerful legs to navigate even the deepest snow. Its keen senses allow it to detect approaching danger through violent blizzards. As it runs, icy energy gathers around its paws, briefly freezing the snow beneath each step.
pokemon.appearance: Lean adolescent white arctic fox with sharp blue eyes, icy-blue markings, spiky fur collar and large bushy tail.
pokemon.notes: Approved #017 Arctivar. Classification and entire Pokédex description deliberately replaced with newly approved Snowrunner Pokémon entry. Preserve existing concept image 017-arctivar.png, normal solo and artwork #017 Arctivar.png. Link the existing stage-specific charcoal-and-purple shiny #017 Arctivar (Shiny).png. Retain prior Arctix moves, assigned ability and cumulative Medium Slow EXP. Arctivar's stage-only moves are Levels 18, 21, 24, 27, 30. Level 32 Ice Beam belongs to Arctivale. No additional evolution-exclusive moves. The standard type chart is unchanged by weather abilities.

pokemon.ability_assignment: An individual Arctivar has either Snow Cloak or Ice Body, not both. Each has an equal 50% assignment chance when Arctix is generated, and the assigned ability is retained through evolution. No hidden ability.

pokemon.name: Arctivale
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Arctivale is a majestic Pokémon that watches over vast frozen territories. Its crystalline fur channels powerful icy energy, allowing it to summon fierce blizzards at will. Despite its overwhelming power, Arctivale is known to guide lost travelers through snowstorms, shielding them from the bitter cold.
pokemon.appearance: Majestic large white arctic fox with thick layered mane, blue crystalline formations along shoulders and back, intense blue eyes and huge bushy tail.
pokemon.notes: Approved #018 Arctivale. Classification changed to Glacial Guardian Pokémon and its exact approved Pokédex entry replaced. Existing concept assignment 018-arctivale.png and normal solo/artwork #018 Arctivale.png remain unchanged. Previously learned moves, accumulated Medium Slow EXP, and assigned Snow Cloak/Ice Body ability persist from Arctix and Arctivar. Pure Ice type. No visual gender differences.

pokemon.name: Joeyjab
pokemon.appearance: Small orange-brown kangaroo with large upright ears, cream chest and muzzle, red boxing gloves and body markings, powerful hind legs, a curved tail, and a determined sparring stance.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Joeyjab is an energetic Pokémon that spends much of its day practicing punches against anything it can find. Its powerful hind legs help it maintain balance while delivering quick combinations with its padded fists. Despite its small size, Joeyjab never backs down from a friendly sparring match.

pokemon.name: Rookick
pokemon.appearance: Orange-brown kangaroo kickboxer with upright ears, cream chest and muzzle, red-and-black boxing gloves, red body markings, raised kicking leg, strong hind legs, curved tail and determined expression.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Rookick is a disciplined fighter that combines lightning-fast punches with devastating kicks. Its powerful hind legs allow it to maintain perfect balance while delivering rapid combinations. It spends hours training against stronger opponents, constantly refining its technique in preparation for tougher battles.

pokemon.name: Kangarush
pokemon.appearance: Fully grown muscular orange-brown kangaroo fighter with upright ears, powerful arms and shoulders, red-and-black boxing gloves, cream chest and muzzle, red lightning-like markings, strong hind legs with clawed feet, long muscular tail, and a confident fighting stance.
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Kangarush is a formidable fighter whose powerful punches and devastating kicks can overwhelm even the toughest opponents. Years of intense training have sharpened its reflexes, allowing it to anticipate attacks and counter with incredible precision. Despite its intimidating strength, Kangarush respects worthy opponents and refuses to strike those unable to defend themselves.

pokemon.name: Tarsik
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Tarsik is a curious Pokémon with an unusual fascination for ancient ruins. The mysterious markings on its fur glow faintly whenever it senses psychic energy nearby. Its enormous eyes allow it to perceive things invisible to most Pokémon, often causing it to stare silently at seemingly empty spaces.
pokemon.appearance: A small, curious tarsier with enormous golden eyes, oversized pink ears, soft mauve-brown fur, cream-colored facial tufts, and a slender curved tail. Glowing purple runes appear on its forehead, body, and tail. It wears a small ancient pendant.
pokemon.notes: Psychic starter family design approved. Only Pokédex identity, artwork and evolution relationships are set. Battle stats, moves, abilities, evolution levels, experience data, EV yields, catch rates and other mechanics remain intentionally unspecified.

pokemon.name: Tarsigil
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Tarsigil spends hours studying the ancient markings found within forgotten ruins. The glowing symbols across its fur react to psychic energy, allowing it to decipher messages left behind by civilizations long gone. When threatened, it creates powerful psychic barriers to protect itself and its companions.
pokemon.appearance: A taller, slender tarsier with large golden eyes, elongated fingers, prominent ears, and more elaborate glowing purple runes. It wears an ancient patterned headband, decorative ornaments, and a gold-trimmed cloth across its shoulders. Its long tail carries illuminated psychic markings.
pokemon.notes: Psychic starter family design approved. Only Pokédex identity, artwork and evolution relationships are set. Battle stats, moves, abilities, evolution levels, experience data, EV yields, catch rates and other mechanics remain intentionally unspecified.

pokemon.name: Tarsage
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Tarsage possesses an extraordinary understanding of the psychic energy that flows through the world. The ancient symbols covering its body glow brilliantly when it unleashes its powers. Legends claim that Tarsage can glimpse events yet to occur and has silently guarded the secrets of forgotten civilizations for centuries.
pokemon.appearance: A majestic, fully developed tarsier with enormous golden eyes, prominent ears, a layered cream-colored mane, long fingers, and an elaborate ancient cloak decorated with golden symbols. Its body and tail display powerful glowing purple runes, while swirling psychic energy surrounds it.

pokemon.name: Ravisp
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Ravisp is a curious Pokémon that wanders through quiet forests and abandoned places. Mysterious purple wisps drift around its feathers, growing brighter whenever it senses nearby spirits. Despite its ghostly appearance, Ravisp is playful and often follows travelers, mimicking their voices to get their attention.

The spectral energy flowing through its feathers allows it to move almost silently and briefly disappear from sight. It communicates with other Ravraith through eerie calls that can be heard from great distances, even through thick fog.

Despite its intimidating appearance, Ravantom is known to protect smaller Pokémon, using its supernatural powers to conceal them from approaching threats.

When startled, Pangrit curls into a tight ball, making itself nearly impossible for smaller predators to harm.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Pangranite possesses an enormous body protected by scales as hard as granite. Its massive claws can tear through solid rock, allowing it to carve vast underground tunnels. Fiercely territorial, Pangranite patrols its underground domain and uses its immense strength to drive away intruders. When threatened, it slams its armored tail against the ground, sending powerful tremors through the surrounding area.

As Cairnram matures, it becomes increasingly competitive, challenging others of its kind in fierce headbutting contests to establish dominance.

pokemon.pokedex_entry: Cairnox rules the highest mountain peaks, where its enormous stone horns serve as a symbol of strength and dominance. Rival Cairnox clash in thunderous headbutting contests that can send tremors through entire mountainsides. Its powerful legs and exceptional balance allow it to charge across narrow cliffs with ease, while its thick wool protects it from the harshest alpine conditions.

pokemon.name: Hornit
pokemon.pokedex_entry: Hornit spends its nights wandering through forests in search of fallen fruit, which it can detect with its sensitive antennae. Its powerful claws allow it to cling firmly to tree trunks, even while carrying objects heavier than itself. Curious by nature, Hornit often investigates unfamiliar objects, sometimes accidentally knocking them over with its developing metallic horn.

Its enlarged metallic horns are used in contests against rival Hornsteel, lifting opponents from branches and forcing them to retreat. Although these competitions can appear fierce, Hornsteel rarely pursues a defeated rival, returning to its peaceful activities once the dispute is settled.

During the day, Hornforge rests among the largest trees in the forest, where its nearly impenetrable exoskeleton protects it from predators. Despite its imposing appearance, it remains calm unless directly threatened.
